answer: The glacier holds work receipts rather than names, so the pearl of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The mesa of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, clawed back after a replayed submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
